scenes.narration: You've never paid for Instagram. So who's paying for it?
In 2025, Meta earned 196 billion dollars from advertising. About 3.6 billion people use its apps every day.
Ads make up about 98 percent of Meta's 201 billion dollars in revenue.

visual.label: Share of Meta revenue from ads

scenes.narration: Its headset and glasses division, Reality Labs, brought in 2.2 billion dollars but lost 19.2 billion.
The apps pay for everything else.
